witness.description: Narrowed fragment: exact finite set S = {1 <= n < 30 : omega(n-j) <= j for all j=1..8}, recomputed from scratch inside the verifier by pure-integer trial division. Hand-checked certificate constants: n-1 must be 1 or a prime power (omega(n-1)<=1), giving candidates n in {2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10,12,14,17,18,20,24,26,28,30}; for each, n-j <= 28 has omega <= 2 <= j for j>=2, so all 17 pass. Hence EXPECTED_COUNT=17, EXPECTED_FIRST=2, EXPECTED_LAST=30.

law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
